answer_1.quote: This task has been well-studied in the community due to its significance in down stream applications such as ordering of: concepts in concept-to-text generation, information from each document in multi-document summarization, events in storytelling, cooking steps in recipe generation, and positioning of new information in existing summaries for update summarization.

answer_2.quote: Perfect Match (PMR): calculates the percentage of samples for which the entire sequence was correctly predicted ... Sentence Accuracy (Acc): measures the percentage of sentences for which their absolute position was correctly predicted ... Kendall Tau (Tau): quantifies the distance between the predicted order and the correct order ... Rouge-S: calculates the percentage of skipbigrams for which the relative order is predicted correctly ... Longest Common Subsequence (LCS): calculates the ratio of longest common sub-sequence ...

answer_4.quote: We introduce a human evaluation experiment to assess the orders predicted by the models. We set up a manual pairwise comparison ... and present the human judges with two orders of the same piece of text. The judges are asked 'Pick the option which is in the right order according to you.'
answer_4.guideline: The judges are asked to pick the option in the right order or select 'No Preference'.
